text:
Paula - PM: Quick sync — after last launch we have three follow-on asks from customers plus a few regression reports. Proposal for the next sprint: 1) urgent truncation bug (customer-facing) — ship a hotfix canary this week; 2) telemetry dashboard (MVP) — deliver next sprint; 3) UX wording tweak — defer. Need owners, ETA, and acceptance criteria. Thoughts? :eyes:
Alex M: I'm happy to own the truncation fix. Quick question — is this a KV/prefix-cache regression or request-level truncation? Any logs to point at root cause?
Mia K: Saw 4 customer reports, all surfaced after the rollback window. Traces show 502s and partial payloads for a subset of requests. I'll pull traces and correlate with model timeout spikes.
Sanjay R: I'll take dashboard work. If we scope to a trimmed MVP (3 widgets + one backend endpoint) I can ship in one sprint. Agree we should defer the UX wording tweak.
Jules (eng): For truncation, short mitigation path: sanitize inputs to enforce a max token limit and bump the model routing timeout from 2000ms -> 3000ms for the affected route. Minimal change: config + one-line lib guard. Example routing snippet:
```
routing_policies:
  - name: short-timeouts-adjust
    model_timeout_ms: 3000
```
Paula - PM: Good. Proposed owners: Alex = hotfix, Mia = validation/sign-off, Jules = config change, Sanjay = dashboard. Acceptance criteria for hotfix: reproducer + unit test, end-to-end smoke passing, and p95 latency within SLO under canary load. Target: canary Friday, full rollout Monday pending go/no-go. Any blockers?
Alex M: No blockers from infra side. I'll open a PR today and tag @Mia K for test validation. ETA for PR: EOD.
Mia K: I'll run e2e with synthetic traces once PR is up and validate canary on staging. I'll also add a smoke test into our monitoring suite to catch regressions.
deploy-bot: Canary started for release/hotfix-1706 at 1706123600 — route: us-west — traffic: 5%.
Paula - PM: Nice — we'll reconvene Monday 10:00AM for go/no-go. Quick backlog rule: if hotfix work exceeds 8 points, we trim dashboard to a single widget MVP. Samll follow-up: add a post-launch regression checklist doc + owner. :thumbsup:
Sanjay R: Understood. I'll prepare a trimmed dashboard spec and wireframe (3 widget and a one-endpoint fallback) and post in #product by EOD Friday.
Jules (eng): I'll draft the regression checklist (short playbook + owner list) and drop it in the repo under docs/postlaunch. Happy to pair with someone from QA.
Paula - PM: Thanks — owners confirmed. I'll create the tasks in the board and set the Monday triage. If anyone spots additional customer reports, ping here and tag the thread. :rocket:
